title: Psychedelic Chicken Shit
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a large purple mushroom with a single spiraled eye and dripping orange liquid, growing from a twisted green tree trunk with a large yellow bird-like eye. Below sits a stone planter labeled 'CHICKEN SHIT' containing colorful flowers, a coiled snake with a glowing orb, a small blue fairy-like figure, and various dripping fungal forms against a starry night sky with a ringed planet.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork of a giant purple mushroom with a hypnotic spiral eye and dripping red-orange liquid, growing from a gnarled green tree trunk that has a large yellow bird eye. The tree emerges from a stone planter labeled CHICKEN SHIT in bold graffiti letters. The scene includes colorful flowers, a coiled snake emitting light, a small blue fairy, red tentacle fungi, all set against a starry night sky with a ringed planet. Vibrant dripping paint effects, intricate details, dark cosmic background.
